tables.preceding_label: F continued. Injection and direction construction
cells: First two constrained fronts; nonfinite crowding values set to zero before shifting and normalizing. Uniform sampling if all shifted weights vanish.
Mean three-neighbor distance divided by itself with a 10-12 floor. Its nonconstant shifted values, when present, contribute half of the sampling distribution.

First sequential gate: probability 0.40 when such directions exist. Mix an elite and a direction-associated parent with coefficient 0.20–0.80; perturb 6–16% of coordinates (at least two), using 1.1 times the base jitter.
Next fresh gate: probability 0.65 if at least two elites exist. Pair with a distant elite, with a 0.35 resampling chance; mixture coefficient 0.15–0.85; Gaussian jitter multiplier 1.2.
Next fresh gates: 0.85 for elite Gaussian mutation (jitter multiplier 2.2), then 0.95 for uniform resampling within 8–92% of each range; otherwise sample across the full bounds.
Half of the six adapted directions. Repeatedly select the remaining population direction with the smallest minimum cosine similarity to the existing and already selected directions.
Other half. For each objective, blend 30% of a remaining direction with a large corresponding coordinate and 70% of an axis-biased vector; normalize and apply the shared jitter.
